title: Complainte
identity: Anne-Marie Mimet's *Complainte sur un thème populaire* is a Billaudot work for E-flat saxophone with piano or harp, catalog GB2228. Billaudot labels it 'moyennement difficile (cycle 2)' and places it in its modern saxophone teaching collection.

evidence.claim: Official publisher confirms instrumentation, piano/harp options, collection, catalog number, and cycle 2 label.
A second dealer corroborates alto saxophone and piano/harp format.
